title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library

tldr.zh:
**Human2Sim2Robot：**单段人类操作视频＋任务指令 → 拆解子任务、识别物体属性 → 重建仿真场景 → 轨迹优化或代码生成，结合仿真验证找到一条成功的机器人轨迹 → 改变物体与机器人初始状态扩增示范、处理渲染外观 → 用所得数据微调 π₀.₅ → 部署真实灵巧手。
**特色：**智能体在各阶段选择或编写工具，根据验证失败反馈反复修正；新工具与验证器保存到库，供后续视频转换复用。“自进化”指工具代码积累，验证反馈作用于数据生成流程。
tldr.en:
**Human2Sim2Robot:** One human demonstration video + task instruction → decompose subtasks and identify object properties → reconstruct a simulation scene → obtain a successful robot trajectory through optimization or code generation with simulation verification → vary initial object/robot states to augment demonstrations and process rendered appearance → fine-tune π₀.₅ on the generated data → deploy on real dexterous hands.
**Distinction:** An agent selects or writes tools at each stage and revises outputs using verifier failure feedback. New tools and verifiers persist for later videos; self-evolution means accumulating reusable code, with verification acting during data generation.

evaluation_scope.zh: 双臂 YamBox＋两只 Sharpa 手，11 个任务；每任务一段人类视频，扩增 500 条机器人示范微调 π₀.₅，随机初始物体状态下每任务闭环评测 10 次，平均成功率 63.6%（最强对照 SPIDER 为 18.2%）。另有开环轨迹回放：11/11 表示每任务 10 次至少成功一次，不代表全部试验成功。覆盖刚体、关节物体、绳索及长程任务；通过仿真检查仍可能有 Sim-to-Real 与力敏感交互失败。
evaluation_scope.en: Bimanual YamBox with two Sharpa hands; 11 tasks. Each task uses one human video and 500 augmented robot demonstrations to fine-tune π₀.₅, evaluated over 10 closed-loop trials with randomized initial object states: 63.6% mean success versus 18.2% for SPIDER, the strongest baseline. Separate open-loop replay passes 11/11 tasks, meaning at least one success in ten trials per task, not perfect trial success. Tasks include rigid, articulated, rope and long-horizon interactions; simulation checks do not eliminate sim-to-real or force-sensitive failures.
